Dense clutter is the hardest case; the overall 80\% success rate on the stacked setting shows the limit.
On glossy surfaces the success rate is 70\%.
See Table~\ref{tab:stacked}.

Ours & 90\% & 80\% & 70\% & 40\% \\ \midrule
Clutter $\rightarrow$ & Sparse & Medium & Dense & Stacked \\
Ours & 90\% & 80\% & 70\% & 50\% \\
\bottomrule
\end{tabular}}
